title: TrainingPeaks TSS Baseline Drift Alert
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout
| timechart span=1d avg(tss) as metric
| eventstats avg(metric) as base, stdev(metric) as sd
| eval delta=round(metric-base,2), drift=if(abs(delta)>2*sd,1,0)
| where drift=1
description: Flags days where trainingpeaks tss moved far away from your recent baseline instead of staying within normal variation.
value: Large baseline drift is a quick way to surface bad days, breakout days, or sensor issues without waiting for a coach's manual review.
implementation: Schedule this daily after ingesting trainingpeaks tss events and investigate any drift days alongside notes about fatigue, travel, or conditions.
visualization: Timechart of daily training stress score with baseline and drift markers.
grandmaExplanation: It compares when trainingpeaks tss suddenly looks very different from your normal pattern.
